title: (No AI) Anthropic CEO says it’s time to pump the brakes on AI
author: Terrence O’Brien
content:
![A digital brain on a leash.](https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/08/STK485_STK414_AI_SAFETY_C.jpg?quality=90&strip=all&crop=0,0,100,100)

Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei says the time has come to slow down AI development and will give third-party evaluators like [METR](https://metr.org/) access to its models to help ensure its "adherence to safety practices and commitments." In a [winding essay](https://darioamodei.com/post/we-must-pace-the-frontier#pacing-within-democracies), Amodei proposed a three-step plan to "pace the frontier" - jargon that simply means to slow the pace of training and development to give companies time to build safeguards and regulators to evaluate models.

Amodei says that giving external evaluators wide-ranging access is just the first step, and one it is [taking now unilaterally](https://www.theverge.com/ai-artificial-intelligence/994064/anthropic-spent-this-week-in-hot-water-over-cybersecurity). Step two would involve the industry coming together as a whole, likely with gove …

[Read the full story at The Verge.](https://www.theverge.com/ai-artificial-intelligence/994337/anthropic-ceo-slow-down-ai-development)

title: (No AI) Trump is giving data centers a pass to pollute
author: Justine Calma
content:
![Photo collage of a data center.](https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/04/STKS528_DATA_CENTERS_D.jpg?quality=90&strip=all&crop=0,0,100,100)

President Donald Trump is weakening environmental regulations in the name of speeding up the construction of AI data centers, raising health risks for Americans, a cadre of former EPA officials said this week in a briefing and new [report](https://www.environmentalprotectionnetwork.org/new-report-ai-data-center-boom-poses-growing-health-risks-as-epa-other-federal-agencies-weaken-protections-against-harmful-pollution/). They are urging - perhaps futilely - the president to adopt a "Data Center Health Protection Pledge" to signal that the administration is taking the environmental threat seriously.

At the start of his term, Trump's EPA administrator, Lee Zeldin, [proclaimed his goal of making America](https://www.theverge.com/2024/11/12/24294483/donald-trump-ai-data-center-epa-lee-zeldin) "[the AI capital of the world](https://www.epa.gov/newsreleases/icymi-administrator-zeldin-fox-news-trumps-epa-clearing-regulatory-path-america)" through deregulation. Since then, Zeldin and the White House have rolled back dozens of rules …
